intro: Live box-opening outcomes, aggregated by chest type and level.
catalogStaleBanner: Item catalog may be outdated (catalog v{{catalogVersion}}, game v{{gameVersion}}). Open the Settings tab to refresh.
lootUnavailable: Loot tracking unavailable: {{reason}}. Open a chest in-game — the reader will re-derive the required offsets and start recording.
noBoxesYet: No boxes opened yet this session. Open a chest in-game with the live reader running to see recorded loot here.
resetAllBody: This clears all recorded box opens for every chest type. The session timer is not affected. This cannot be undone.

boxSection.sinceTitle: Hourly rate measured since this time (resets on Reset)
boxSection.unclassifiedHint: Box type couldn't be read from memory. Assign each item to a chest category to include it in the stats.
boxSection.resetBody: This clears all recorded opens and history for this box. The session timer is not affected. This cannot be undone.
boxSection.ringDialogBody: How long one full traversal of the border ring takes. The ring fills clockwise from the top each time a chest of this type drops; completed laps layer underneath in a warmer color.
